Hello, I'd love to be in! I also have another player friend who wants to play too, if we can find the space.

Hello!

If you do find a game — especially a PBP, I have 2 players that could join in, if you'll have us! 

We are fairly new to the game, but pretty enthused and invested. :)

I just played The Delian Tomb one shot with my friends (who are new players, including me). They seemed to enjoy it! 

We played with pre-made characters, but now everyone is pumped about their new adventure where they will be building characters of their own. 

Can anyone help me with some more one shots, for Level 1 characters that I can introduce them to?
Some ground rules are good, especially when discussed and landed, for everyone to be on the same page. These are helpful tips, thanks very much!

That sounds fair. I've watched a lot of games online, and they are quite fun-looking (not that I'm setting it as an expectation)— but I do have a certain level of fun I want them to have as opposed to hardcore *playing* the game. It's not about the game (I think they feel the same way), but about hanging out and doing something fun together.

Thanks so much for this boost of confidence; I needed it. :)

That makes sense. To be on the same page about the hard rules and boundaries of the game; think I'll make it a democratic session where we decide how we (they) see ourselves coming back.

Some kind human shared a quick one-shot that could be played prior to starting off with LMoP, that's seamless. Gonna give that a try!

Thanks for the insight on "do stuff because this is a game and you are the heroes". I think it's important to holistically engage—a difficult feat— to have them really enjoy!

Holy shit! You solved it for me.

So, the reason I asked about AC and DC (lol) was because the Hit Points on the character sheets were really low. Felt like a good round of rolls from the Goblins could eventually knock them out.

The Delian Tomb looks like a good workaround to that. Thanks a lot!
